highlights: **End-to-end ownership:** Own BBRaiN across its Rust inference service, vendor hub, admin console and GPU training pipeline; deployed inside each client's own cloud (VPC).
**Agentic AI in production:** Built an admin assistant agent that turns plain-language requests into audited configuration changes through typed write tools.
**AI in the binary:** Serve vision, embedding and ranking models from a single Rust service on CPU, with no GPU runtime, within a tight latency budget.

**Guardrails and licensing:** Built fail-closed content safety controls, per-feature licensing, and custom security validation tooling in Rust (Offensive Rust methodologies) to prevent adversarial manipulation and unauthorized feature execution.
**AI integration:** Integrated ML models and LLM APIs into Go, Java and Python microservices over REST and gRPC.
**LLM features:** Built prompt, retrieval (RAG) and structured-output features for client-facing tools.
**Data preparation:** Cleaned, transformed and validated client datasets for modelling and analytics.
**Prototype to production:** Turned validated AI prototypes into services with Docker, CI pipelines and monitoring.
**Evaluation and docs:** Tested model outputs against baselines and documented APIs.
**Service performance:** Cut inter-service overhead by 30% by moving services to Golang and gRPC.
**Streaming pipelines:** Ran Kafka pipelines with sub-second ingestion for real-time monitoring.
**Team standards:** Set code-quality and DevSecOps standards and mentored engineers.
**Real-time systems:** Built Golang (REST, WebSockets) and Java Spring Boot backends for international startups.
**Full-stack delivery:** Integrated Angular frontends with Go and Java backends through well-documented APIs.
**Reliability:** Deployed Dockerized services with auto-scaling and monitoring, holding 99% uptime.
